'''''Star Wars: Invasion''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series written by [[Tom Taylor]] and illustrated by [[Colin Wilson (artist)|Colin Wilson]]. Published by [[Dark Horse Comics]], the series is set in the [[New Jedi Order era]] and depicts the events of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Just like another ongoing series by Dark Horse—''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''—it tied in with the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|New Jedi Order]]'' novels by [[Del Rey]] while still remaining accessible to new readers. It launched with two online-only preview issues on [[StarWars.com]] in May and June 2009. The first printed issue was published on [[July 1]], [[2009]].<ref name="CC1" /> It was published monthly in five-issue story arcs alternating with [[Star Wars: Dark Times|''Dark Times'']].<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.newsarama.com/comics/090212-star-wars-dark-horse.html|text=Dark Horse Prepares the Star Wars Universe for an Invasion|archivedate=20090216025227}}</ref> 

The last issue was released in November of 2011, with no further issues planned.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://forcecast.net/story/home/Jedi_Journals_April_2013_150949.asp|text=ForceCast.net podcast with Randy Stradley |archivedate=20130615043643}}</ref>
